patterns: APPSC asks single-fact AP e-governance items: which CM launched e-Pragati (Naidu), MeeSeva start (Nov 2011), MANA TV for MeeSeva training, MEDHAS full form / sector, CARD award finalist.
Policy questions use the 'NOT a target' shape (Electronics Mfg Policy 4.0: 2 lakh entrepreneurs is the odd one out).
Location recall: IT/ITES SEZ = Visakhapatnam; Fiber Grid Phase-I covered 13 districts.
App MCQs are dominated by multi-statement items with 2025-26 current-affairs numbers (Google AI hub, Quantum Valley, Drone policy targets) far deeper than PYQs, which stay at name/date/acronym level.
